attackers_goals: Collect information about the host, network and user configuration for lateral movement and privilege escalation.
description: A process performed multiple consecutive container discovery commands from within a Kubernetes Pod.
investigative_actions: Verify if the script or process initiating the discovery commands is benign. Verify that this isn't sanctioned IT activity. Look for other hosts executing similar commands.
name: Suspicious container reconnaissance activity in a Kubernetes pod
